name: input_changeschedule_reselect
about: ChangeSchedule '-' forces a reselection. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::InputChangeSchedule 0x102c33f0 (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/authored-control.md § 'Direct schedule changes'): a name other than '-' is written to the forced-schedule word +0x65c8; in every case flags2 |= 0x82000000 (CHOOSE_NEW), so at the next think PreSelect drops the running program and a schedule is selected again. Param verbatim from hw_sinbin_1 (Kerri '-'). sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg) verbatim, the player at the start, in its view.
known_red: new: ChangeSchedule '-' forces no reselection (retail sets CHOOSE_NEW 0x82000000 in flags2 on every call, 0x102c33f0)
